newsitem.title: USA: Western Resources says studying Tyco/ADT pact.
newsitem.headline: Western Resources says studying Tyco/ADT pact.

text.p: Western Resources Inc said it is examining Tyco International Ltd's $5.6 billion friendly merger pact with ADT Ltd, a company Western is pursuing with a $3.5 billion cash-and-stock hostile bid.
"At this point, we are in the process in reviewing and studying their offer," a Western spokesman said, declining to comment further.
Western is ADT's largest shareholder with a 27 percent stake in the company.
Tyco's bid values ADT at about $29 per share versus the $22.50 per share bid from Western.
Western launched its hostile takeover attempt three months ago, and ADT has rejected the offer as inadequate.
